findings.description: The loop no longer removes a parameter's secondary_opts from the help option names, so a help name that is also a secondary option of another parameter (e.g. a flag declared as "--x/-h") is now kept as a help name.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has a parameter whose secondary_opts includes a default help name such as "-h". Before this change that name was removed from the help names, so no conflict arose. After the change, the help option keeps "-h" as well, so the name is claimed twice and the parser or help behavior can conflict or resolve to the wrong option. Impact: the user may see a conflicting-option error or have "-h" trigger help instead of the intended flag. I am not certain the removal was intended, which is why confidence is moderate.
